chart_data_needs.title: Annual Economic Losses from Weather Disasters in China (2016-2026)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: How have annual economic losses from weather disasters trended over the past decade, and what is the 2026 estimate?
required_metrics: Annual economic losses (RMB billion) from weather disasters in China for years 2016-2026
preferred_sources: Ministry of Emergency Management (MEM) annual disaster reports
National Bureau of Statistics of China
search_queries: China annual economic losses weather disasters 2016 2026 official data
Ministry of Emergency Management China disaster loss statistics 2026
China weather disaster economic loss trend 2016 2026
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use official government or international organization data. If 2026 data is preliminary, mark as estimate. Require at least 4 annual data points; if only two endpoints are found, use CAGR to interpolate and label as estimates.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Establishes the scale and urgency of the disaster impact, setting the stage for investment opportunities.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: The report claims that 2026 losses exceed ¥68B, but we need to show the historical trend to contextualize this figure.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: Losses have been volatile but generally increasing, with 2026 representing a peak, underscoring the need for resilience investment.
